Since #26073 (ruling A′ 6417934431) the page is also renamed to `concepts/architecture-overview`. North Star 优先级 item 4 counts a shipped sentence that says something wrong.

Dedupe: titles of the first 500 `documentation`-labelled issues (open and closed) grepped for `north.?star` → #26073 only (the rename, which leaves these files alone by its claim). The search API is not available from this seat.

- `packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts:59`: `@see content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx §8 "No private expression DSL"`. Shipped (`files` has `src/**/*.zod.ts`), and it renders into `content/docs/references/shared/expression.mdx`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/environment-artifact.zod.ts:46`: `See {@link content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx} §6.3 …`. Shipped; renders into `content/docs/references/system/environment-artifact.mdx`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts:256`: `@see content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx — "Metadata-only runtime"` (no such heading on the page).
- `packages/formula/src/index.ts:8` and `packages/formula/README.md:9` (README shipped): `north-star.mdx §8 "No private expression DSL"`.

## Wanted

Point each citation at the section that actually states the claim (after #26073 lands: `content/docs/concepts/architecture-overview.mdx`, e.g. its Principles section, or `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` where the claim is a priority), or drop the section number. Then regenerate the references (`gen:docs`) and add one patch changeset per package. ⛔ No change to any schema shape.

## Acceptance

`git grep -n 'north-star.mdx' -- packages/` → 0, positive control `git grep -n 'architecture' -- packages/spec/src | head -1` hits; the references check is green.
